title: O Astrapogiannos
actors: Nikos Kourkoulos, Niki Triantafillidi, Giannis Argyris
plot: The battle-scarred hero of the Greek Revolution, Giannos "Astrapogiannos", returns home after the end of the blood-soaked War of Independence, only to find himself in a new conflict, as he locks horns with a ruthless local Kodjaba...
